name: Flare
doc: Flare (spell): one target task per action, in turn (one every 10 ticks, not while one of 60 ticks or less runs on that target): a screen flash, two fades, the target turning red and back, a burst layout at its effect position and a ring at its feet scaled by its size, over ticks 40..79 the target hidden and redrawn rippled, sparks collapsing into it and bursting out; the result at 80, the end with both layouts.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values): where it is in FF8_EN.exe and its size. A new effect copies it into its program ("data").

ripple.doc: three tables, one after the other (the distance lookup reads one row past its own): u8 [128][128] the distance of (|dy|, |dx|) on screen; u16 [20][128] a vertex's offset weight by its distance (4.12), per ripple step; s16 [4096] the wobble

red.doc: the colour the target turns (RGB + code)

magic_buffer.doc: Offsets in the magic buffer: the two packet arenas the director alternates, the layouts' blended vertex frames (after the target and spark nodes).

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The root starts one target task per action, in turn (not while a young one runs on that target); each target task's clock: its sound, the screen flash and fades, the target's red tint, its result; it ends when both layouts have finished

parts.title: Burst
parts.doc: The burst layout at the target's effect position, scaled by its size

parts.title: Ring
parts.doc: The ring layout at the target's feet

parts.title: Silhouette
parts.doc: The target hidden and redrawn rippled around its effect position

parts.title: Sparks
parts.doc: Sprites on a sphere around the target that collapse into it, then burst out

groups.label: Depth
groups.doc: Its drawing depth: (Base - the target's size word) >> Shift (objects 2 and 3: >> 2 more)

groups.label: Size
groups.doc: Both layouts scaled by ((the target's size >> 1) + Base) >> Shift (4096 = their own size); the sparks' radius too

params.label: Every
params.doc: The root starts the next action's target task every this many ticks

params.label: Busy tick
params.doc: Not while a target task on that target is at this tick or before (the cycle restarts; -1: never)

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The sound block played (its world sound id: an audio.dat entry)

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound plays at the target's effect position when the target tick == this

params.label: Sound volume
params.doc: BdPlaySE3D's volume argument

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The action's target takes the result when the target tick == this

params.label: Flash rise
params.doc: The screen flash rises (Up a tick) before this tick...

params.label: Flash level
params.doc: ...stays at least at this level...

params.label: Flash fall after
params.doc: ...and falls (Down a tick) to 0 at End after this tick

params.label: Fade tick
params.doc: A screen fade starts at this tick

params.label: Flash set tick
params.doc: At this tick the flash level is set (and a second fade starts)...

params.label: Flash set level
params.doc: ...to this

params.label: Red from
params.doc: The target turns red from this tick...

params.label: Red ticks
params.doc: ...over this many ticks...

params.label: Red shift
params.doc: ...its weight (tick - from) << this (4096 = red)

params.label: Back from
params.doc: It turns back from this tick...

params.label: Back ticks
params.doc: ...over this many ticks...

params.label: Back shift
params.doc: ...its weight (tick - from) << this

params.label: From tick
params.doc: The target is redrawn rippled from this tick...

params.label: Ticks
params.doc: ...for this many ticks (the ripple grows and shrinks back)

params.label: Last tick
params.doc: Sparks are spawned at target ticks 0 .. this...

params.label: Count
params.doc: ...this many a tick

params.label: Collapse window
params.doc: Each collapses at a random tick in a window this long

params.label: Turn
params.doc: Its direction turns this much a tick

params.label: Sprite size
params.doc: Its sprite's size (4096 = its own)

params.label: Burst tick
params.doc: It bursts out from this tick of its own...

params.label: Fade tick
params.doc: ...and fades out from this one

tasks.doc: One per action: its sound at the target's effect position; the screen flash level raised (risen, held, fallen), two fades; the target marked (flags 0x800) and turned red then back; the burst at the target's effect position and the ring at its feet, scaled by its size (record flags 0x40000: angles in YXZ order; 0x1000: the offset through the effect camera; 0x200; 0x100), objects 2 and 3 at a quarter depth; the silhouette; sparks over its first ticks; the result; it ends when both layouts have finished.
A sprite on a sphere around the target, its direction turning: it shows at its spawn radius, collapses into the centre at its own random tick, bursts out again and fades out.
